release_notes.en-US:
Copy links: get the links out of a saved session without opening it.

- Right-click a tab-group header in the tab list (or click its copy icon) to copy all the group's links, one per line, ready to paste into Firefox or anywhere else. This works for old groups that Firefox's own saved groups no longer have.
- The same "Copy N links" is in the window menu, the session menu and each tab's right-click menu.
- "Copy as Markdown" gives a list of titled links, with group and window headings, ready for notes apps.
- Keys: Ctrl+C copies the links of the focused tab, group header or session; Ctrl+Shift+C copies Markdown. Group headers are now stops when you move through the tab list with the arrow keys, and Shift+F10 opens a tab's or group's menu.
- Duplicate links are copied once, and the notice says how many were left out. Switch this off in Settings → Popup.
- Tabs that hadn't loaded yet are copied as their real link, not the placeholder page.
- No new permissions: copying only happens when you click or press a key.
